title: Mild Cognitive Impairment Guidelines: Guidelines Summary

Practice guideline update summary: Mild cognitive impairment: Report of the Guideline Development, Dissemination, and Implementation Subcommittee of the American Academy of Neurology.
The following organizations have released guidelines for the management of mild cognitive impairment. Key diagnostic and treatment recommendations have been reviewed and integrated throughout the article.
